title: Sprint is a dumb word for how to develop. Yes sprints are short and fast but they are not sustainable. I'd rather have a team of running buddies I can
summary: Sprint is a dumb word for how to develop. Yes sprints are short and fast but they are not sustainable. I'd rather have a team of running buddies I can rely upon and call up and say, "Wanna hit the trails" rather than constant churn of 100-meter dash runners.
author: Greg McVerry
body_html: Sprint is a dumb word for how to develop. Yes sprints are short and fast but they are not sustainable. I'd rather have a team of running buddies I can rely upon and call up and say, "Wanna hit the trails" rather than constant churn of 100-meter dash runners.
